I’m not able to pull live exchange‑rate data right now, but as a rough estimate you can use the recent average rate of about $1 ≈ £0.78. Using that:

\[
\$20 \times 0.78 \approx £15.60
\]

So $20 would be roughly £15½–£16, depending on the exact day and the bank’s fee structure. For an accurate figure you’d want to check a reliable financial news source or your bank’s currency converter.
